verdict.rationale: Plaid is a SaaS financial-data API, so choosing a storage region or data residency is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a region or residency choice. The European Payments coverage across 18 markets and the PSD2/Open Banking use describe where Plaid operates, not where customer data is stored, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
